Loads executable program data for v1-v4 loaders and derives SBPF version limits from features.

# Purpose
`fd_prog_load.c` provides program loading helpers for executable accounts. The main entry point, [`fd_prog_load_elf`](<#fd_prog_load_elf>), reads a program account from the account database and returns a pointer to the program ELF data with its size. It supports the Solana BPF loader variants used by the runtime: v1/v2 loaders, the upgradeable v3 loader, and the v4 loader. Each loader type uses a different account layout, so the file includes separate helper functions to locate and validate the executable program content for each case.

The file also defines [`fd_prog_versions`](<#fd_prog_versions>), which selects the minimum and maximum supported SBPF version from active feature flags at a given slot, and [`fd_prog_load_env_from_bank`](<#fd_prog_load_env_from_bank>), which fills a `fd_prog_load_env_t` structure from bank state such as features, slot, epoch, and epoch start slot. Together, these functions connect program loading with feature activation and bank context, and they expose the data needed by the runtime to load and validate executable programs.
